svg.title: Class balance does not guarantee source balance
svg.desc: Frozen registry 9496e61b050fc8b62ccbc59cb737376396205a3356b323733b9b8915d56600e1. Fold 0 has 8 MS training sources and 23 MS clips; one source provides 13 clips. Current class-balanced logistic regression gives every MS clip the same loss weight, so this source accounts for 56.5% of the MS part of the assigned data-loss weights. Proposed source-and-class weighting would give each MS source 12.5%, divided across its clips. The self-supervised encoder already samples all 24 training sources uniformly. These weights do not measure accuracy or actual gradient influence. The probe change is not implemented.
